benefits.name: Air Canada credit
benefits.notes: Up to $50 Jan 1-Jun 30 and up to $50 Jul 1-Dec 31 each calendar year on purchases made directly with Air Canada (tickets via agencies/third parties, gift cards, car rentals, hotels and Wi-Fi excluded).

benefits.name: Global Entry / TSA PreCheck
benefits.notes: Up to $120 statement credit for the Global Entry, TSA PreCheck or NEXUS application fee, once every 4 years.

benefits.name: Instacart credit
benefits.notes: $10 credit loaded into your Instacart+ account each month; requires an active Instacart+ membership (3 months complimentary, then paid) and an order paid with the card. Unused credit expires at month end.

benefits.name: DoorDash promo
benefits.notes: $10 off one non-restaurant DoorDash order each calendar quarter if DashPass was first activated with the card 2/1/2025-8/31/2026; activations 9/1/2026-12/31/2027 get it each calendar month instead. Runs through 12/31/2027.

benefits.name: Aeroplan 25K status
benefits.notes: Automatic Aeroplan 25K status as a cardmember with no spend requirement: priority check-in, priority boarding (Zone 2), extra baggage allowance, Star Alliance recognition, eUpgrade credits.

benefits.name: FLY15OFF award discount
benefits.notes: At least 15% fewer Aeroplan points on the base fare of eligible Air Canada flight reward redemptions; account must be linked to Aeroplan.

benefits.name: Free first checked bags
benefits.notes: Cardmember and up to 8 others on the same reservation get the first checked bag free on Air Canada flights.

benefits.name: 5,000 SQC each year
benefits.notes: 5,000 Status Qualifying Credits each calendar year as primary cardmember; card SQC capped at 25,000 per Aeroplan member per calendar year.

benefits.name: 10,000 SQC after $25K spend
benefits.notes: 10,000 SQC when you spend $25,000 in a calendar year (spend resets each Jan 1).

benefits.name: 10,000 more SQC after $50K spend
benefits.notes: Additional 10,000 SQC when you spend $50,000 in a calendar year (spend resets each Jan 1).

benefits.name: Aeroplan 35K status after $75K
benefits.notes: Aeroplan 35K status (adds priority security clearance) for the rest of the calendar year and the next one after $75,000 in purchases in a calendar year.
